title: Wetin A1, A2, B1, B2, C1 an C2 mean?
invitation: Dis small-small level code dey show for book, class, exam, app an language profile for everywhere. Here you go learn wetin dem really mean, why your different skill fit dey different level, an how Gef dey use dem.
summary: Gef dey use CEFR A1 reach C2 as common map for language ability, e keep Pre-A1 for first steps, an for im own selector e add one clear Gef-only description above C2: ‘Fully fluent / Native level’. But your real ability fit still different for reading, listening, speaking, writing, interaction an mediation.

blocks.title: One common map for language ability
blocks.text: A1 reach C2 come from Common European Framework of Reference for Languages, wey people dey call CEFR. E give learners, teachers, schools, exams an publishers one common way to talk about language ability. A an B no be school grade. Di scale start from early basic communication, then e dey move go language use wey dey more independent, flexible an precise. Gef dey use dis coordinates because di same general map fit work for plenty languages without pretending say every language get di same vocabulary or grammar road.

blocks.title: Pre-A1 · First steps
blocks.text: Pre-A1 na di space before A1. You fit recognize some words, signs, sounds, names, numbers or expressions wey you cram, but you still need plenty help. Modern CEFR material get Pre-A1, so Gef no need invent A0 wey go look official. Gef keep Pre-A1 for lessons, diagnosis an early progress. But for simple self-rating slider, di middle mean no knowledge and di first ring outside na A1, so di visual scale go easy to understand.

blocks.title: A1 · Beginner
blocks.text: For A1, you fit do useful things with small language. Familiar topics an concrete situations na where you strong pass. You fit understand short simple material, exchange basic information, recognize common language for context, and tell person wetin you need now-now. Help still matter, and unfamiliar situation fit hard quick. To move toward A2 mean make you depend less on crammed scripts and feel okay for more everyday situations.

blocks.title: A2 · Everyday
blocks.text: For A2, normal everyday life start to manageable for di language. You usually fit catch di main meaning of short direct material and share basic information about familiar people, places, activities, work or school, shopping, travel, time and immediate needs. Your range still limited, but you fit do more than repeat prepared sentence. To move toward B1 mean connect ideas for longer stretch, handle situation wey no too predictable, explain simple reasons, and depend less on another person to carry di exchange.

blocks.title: B1 · Independent
blocks.text: B1 na where independent language use dey show well. You fit handle many normal situations without planning every sentence before. For familiar topics, you fit follow di main meaning of clear longer language and communicate connected ideas about experiences, plans, preferences, opinions and problems. Gaps and misunderstanding still dey, but dem no stop every conversation or text. To move toward B2 mean increase your range, detail, speed and control so more complex material still dey manageable.

blocks.title: B2 · Strong independent
blocks.text: For B2 you fit join long communication well and handle language wey complex well-well. You fit follow and discuss concrete or abstract ideas, explain your position with detail, and work for many social, academic and professional situations without person always simplifying things for you. Errors and gaps still dey, but you get enough range to work around plenty of dem. To move toward C1 mean finer control of inference, nuance, register, organization and style.

blocks.title: C1 · Advanced
blocks.text: For C1, language don become flexible tool instead of constant obstacle. You fit handle demanding material, understand meaning wey dem no always talk direct, and communicate for long with strong organization and precision. You fit adjust to many social, academic and professional situations and choose tone and style on purpose. To move toward C2 no really be to collect one last grammar list; na to add depth: subtle differences, quick rewording, specialist fields, cultural range and precise control when language complex well-well.

blocks.title: C2 · Very high proficiency
blocks.text: C2 na di highest common reference level for CEFR. C2 user fit handle very demanding language for many situations with fine control of meaning, structure, implication and style. C2 no mean say you know every word, never make mistake, or your identity don turn to native speaker. Languages too big for that. Even experts and people wey don speak am all their life still meet vocabulary and fields wey dem no know.

blocks.title: Fully fluent / Native level · Gef top self-description
blocks.text: Gef add one more choice above C2 for im own self-rating: Fully fluent / Native level. Dis one no be CEFR C3 and no be official outside certificate. Na practical choice for person wey im current command of that skill mature, broad, automatic and fit compare with fully fluent adult native speaker. Person wey no be native speaker fit choose am too if di description really fit. Gef dey describe ability here, no be ancestry.

blocks.title: Your language ability na shape, no be one letter
blocks.text: One level convenient, but real ability no dey equal. Gef fit keep six axes: Reading, Listening, Speaking, Writing, Interaction and Mediation. You fit read for C1, understand speech for B2, write for B1 and speak for A2. Nothing wrong with that. Six-side radar graph dey show di differences instead of squeezing everything into one fake-perfect number.

blocks.title: Level no be checklist of every old lesson
blocks.text: Language learning dey rough and uneven. You fit miss one early grammar principle and still develop advanced skill somewhere else. You fit know sophisticated vocabulary or handle hard conversation while one surprisingly basic gap still dey. Gef suppose use levels to describe di overall pattern of wetin you fit do, no be pretend say B2 mean every A1 and A2 lesson complete perfect. Old gaps na things to teach, no be reason to erase stronger abilities wey you already get.

blocks.title: Right now Gef dey measure reading, no be your whole hexagon
blocks.text: Today Gef na reading-first app. You fit tell Gef your own estimate for all six skills, but books, reading lessons, comprehension and dictionary behavior fit only add evidence to your Reading estimate for now. Gef no suppose quietly decide how you speak, listen, write, interact or mediate from things wey you do while reading. Other axes ready for future features without pretending say those features already dey today.

blocks.title: A2 book dey tell you about di book
blocks.text: If Gef mark one book A2, na reading-difficulty signal. E mean say di language for di book target around A2 reading demand. Finishing am na useful evidence about your reading, but e no suddenly prove say your speaking, listening, writing, interaction and mediation all be A2 too. Same rule for tests: always ask wetin dem actually measure.

blocks.title: Wetin be mediation?
blocks.text: Mediation na to help meaning cross one gap. Translation and live interpreting na obvious examples, but e wide pass that. You dey mediate when you summarize hard text for person wey no fit use di original, explain idea with simpler language, relay information between people wey no share language, reword disagreement so both sides fit understand, or combine information from different sources into something another person fit use. E measure how well you fit help meaning travel, no be just how many words you fit translate.

blocks.title: Course progress fit give useful clue
blocks.text: Some learning apps publish how their scale relate to CEFR. Duolingo Score na one example: for their published course scale, 0–29 na A1, 30–59 A2, 60–99 B1, 100–129 B2, 130–159 C1 and 160 C2. Score inside one band fit show whether you just enter that course territory or you don move deeper. But course progress no be independent test of every skill, especially if you skip material or learn plenty elsewhere. Gef keep di original score and treat di relationship as evidence, no be destiny.

blocks.title: World get different language-level systems
blocks.text: CEFR no be di only scale. ACTFL common for language education for United States. Interagency Language Roundtable, ILR, dey use 0–5 scale for U.S. government contexts. Canada dey use Canadian Language Benchmarks for English and NCLC for French. Japanese learners often meet Japanese-Language Proficiency Test, JLPT, from N5 to N1. Mandarin learners fit meet HSK, Chinese proficiency test. Dem design these systems for different purposes, so Gef keep dem separate instead of pretending say every label get perfect twin.

blocks.title: Useful example: Japanese JLPT
blocks.text: Starting from December 2025 Japanese-Language Proficiency Test, pass result fit include official CEFR reference level based on JLPT level and total score. Di important catch na scope: JLPT test language knowledge, reading and listening. E no test speaking, writing or interaction. So even official cross-reference suppose update only abilities wey di evidence really cover.

blocks.title: Chinese HSK dey change, so date matter
blocks.text: HSK na standardized Mandarin Chinese proficiency test. Di familiar HSK 2.0 get six levels and historically publish simple relationship with CEFR. Di newer HSK 3.0 model design around three stages and nine levels, but rollout for 2026 still dey transitional. So Gef store di HSK version and treat any current nine-level-to-CEFR conversion as estimate unless di testing authority publish formal concordance.

blocks.title: Framework no be same thing as test
blocks.text: CEFR na framework to describe proficiency. Different exams, schools and organizations fit design assessments and relate results to am. So score need context: which skills dem test, how dem link di test to di framework, when dem establish di relationship, and whether result official or approximate. Gef fit estimate progress for learning, but e no suppose show app estimate as official CEFR certification.

blocks.title: No universal A2 word count dey
blocks.text: Vocabulary matter, but CEFR no define A1, A2 or B1 with one universal number of words. Researchers for each language build separate reference inventories because languages arrange meaning differently. Even wetin count as one ‘word’ change with segmentation, writing system, compounds and morphology. English vocabulary estimate no fit just copy go Japanese, Arabic, Turkish, Mandarin or any other language.

blocks.title: How Gef dey use levels
blocks.text: Gef dey use CEFR A1–C2 as common coordinate system, Pre-A1 for first steps, and im own ‘Fully fluent / Native level’ at di top of manual selector. Books carry reading difficulty. Learner profiles fit keep six skill values. Level badge fit open dis lesson directly at di relevant section. Then language-specific curriculum data fit describe useful concepts, word senses, grammar patterns, scripts and text types for that stage without blindly translating English word list.

blocks.title: Gef estimate no be diploma
blocks.text: When Gef later combine repeated evidence into im own estimate, English fit call am Gefstimate. We no go force di pun into every language. Under di joke, di meaning serious: Gef estimate na di best evidence-based estimate of your current ability for one particular skill. E no be official CEFR certificate, and Gef suppose always fit explain which evidence contribute to am.

blocks.title: How you go move to next level?
blocks.text: No be by filling one magic progress bar. Future Gef estimates fit combine repeated evidence across different materials and situations: lesson performance, difficulty of wetin you read successfully, how much help you need, comprehension results and other signals wey truly belong to di skill. Vocabulary growth and grammar knowledge fit support di evidence, but none become one single gate. One easy book no suppose promote you, and one hard day no suppose demote you. Automatic placement and adaptive testing na future infrastructure, no be something today reader suppose pretend say e already measure.

blocks.title: Short version
blocks.description: Zero mean no knowledge yet. Pre-A1 na first steps. A1 and A2 build basic everyday ability. B1 and B2 show growing independence. C1 and C2 describe advanced, flexible, precise proficiency. Above that Gef offer im own ‘Fully fluent / Native level’ self-description. Your real ability na di six-side shape of wetin you truly fit do.
